summary: AEye, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing entry into an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners under which it may sell up to $50,000,000 of common stock from time to time as sales agent. Shares issue under the existing Form S-3 shelf (No. 333-296038), with A.G.P. paid up to 3.0% commission plus reimbursement of specified expenses capped at $50,000. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program, not a special situation; no price, premium, or closing terms stated.
